description: Daily Bitcoin market data from CryptoMatter, aligned to a complete calendar and prepared for later regime-model feature engineering.
grain: One row per calendar date, from the earliest to the latest date returned by any requested series.
date_convention: The API provides a calendar date without a time or timezone in this endpoint; the exact daily cutoff has not been verified.
unit_convention: Price, market capitalization, and trade-volume units are preserved from the API. Their quote currency and volume denomination have not been verified.
missing_value_policy: An empty CSV field means unavailable. Missing dates and values are not forward-filled or backward-filled. A genuine numeric zero remains zero unless the field is a closing price, for which nonpositive values are invalid.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Calendar date for this row, derived from the API CreationDate field or inserted to complete the calendar.

columns.name: close_raw
columns.description: Unchanged BTC Close value returned by the API; zero values are retained for auditing.
columns.unit: API price unit; quote currency unverified
columns.missing: Blank when the API has no Close observation for the date.

columns.name: close
columns.description: Cleaned closing price used for returns and rolling features. Equals close_raw only when close_raw is positive.
columns.missing: Blank when close_raw is missing, zero, or negative.

columns.name: market_cap
columns.description: BTC Market_cap value returned by the API, without transformation.
columns.missing: Blank when the API has no Market_cap observation.

columns.name: trade_volume
columns.description: BTC Trade_volume value returned by the API, without transformation. An observed zero is kept as zero.
columns.unit: API volume unit; base/quote denomination unverified
columns.missing: Blank when the API has no Trade_volume observation.

columns.name: has_close
columns.description: 1 when close is valid and positive; 0 otherwise.

columns.name: invalid_close
columns.description: 1 when the API supplied a nonpositive close_raw value; 0 when it supplied a positive value or no value.

columns.name: has_market_cap
columns.description: 1 when market_cap is present, including an observed zero; 0 when missing.

columns.name: has_trade_volume
columns.description: 1 when trade_volume is present, including an observed zero; 0 when missing.

columns.name: zero_trade_volume
columns.description: 1 when the API supplied trade_volume exactly equal to zero; 0 otherwise. This is a quality flag, not a correction.

columns.name: price_change
columns.description: close[t] - close[t-1 calendar day]. This is the absolute daily price difference used by the 2021 common-regime paper.
columns.missing: Blank unless both consecutive calendar days have valid closes.

columns.name: simple_return
columns.missing: Blank unless both consecutive calendar days have valid closes.

columns.name: log_return
columns.description: Natural logarithm of close[t] / close[t-1 calendar day].
columns.missing: Blank unless both consecutive calendar days have valid closes.

columns.name: volatility_30d_annualized
columns.description: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the latest 30 consecutive daily log returns, multiplied by sqrt(365) for a 365-day crypto year.
columns.missing: Blank until 30 consecutive valid daily log returns are available.

columns.name: drawdown_from_30d_peak
columns.description: close[t] / maximum close over the current and previous 29 calendar days - 1. This measures decline from the trailing peak; it is not the maximum drawdown over the window.
columns.missing: Blank unless all 30 calendar days in the window have valid closes.
